# Mempool RPC commands

<!-- This file is generated by `contrib/devtools/gen-rpc-docs.py`. Do not edit it manually. -->

The `Mempool` category of the DeFiChain JSON-RPC interface exposes 1 command. The text below is the help output of the node itself, so it matches the binary that generated this page.

For the complete interface, see the [RPC and CLI reference](../index.md).

## submitpackage

```text
submitpackage ["rawtx",...]
Submit a package of raw transactions (serialized, hex-encoded) to the local node (-regtest only).
The package will be validated according to consensus and mempool policy rules. If all transactions pass, they will be accepted to the mempool.
This RPC is experimental and the interface may be unstable.
Warning: until package relay is in use, successful submission does not mean the transactions will propagate to other nodes on the network.

Arguments:
1. package         (json array, required) An array of raw transactions.
     [
       "rawtx",    (string)
       ...
     ]

Result:
{
  "tx-results": [          (array) the result of every transaction of the package, in the order of the given transactions
    {
      "txid"           (string) The transaction hash in hex
      "allowed"        (boolean) If the mempool allows this tx to be inserted
      "reject-reason"  (string) Rejection string (only present when 'allowed' is false)
      "vsize"          (numeric) Virtual transaction size as defined in BIP 141
      "fees": {        (object) Transaction fees
        "base"        (string) transaction fee in DFI
      }
    }
  ]
}

Examples:
> defi-cli submitpackage [rawtx1, rawtx2]
```
